notes.title: Quick update on my new game Mayhem In Single Valley
notes.notes:
I've been very busy developing my new game [url=http://fluxscopic.com/mayhem-in-single-valley/] Mayhem In Single Valley [/url]. I can confirm the game has player stats, basic crafting, a quest manager, a proper save option, plus some J.J. Abrams-esque secret stuff I can't speak about right now : )

If you haven't seen the [url=http://fluxscopic.com/mayhem-in-single-valley/] official homepage [/url] yet, why not check it out? You'll discover screenshots, animation previews, teaser posters, a dev blog, and more. The game is turning out to me a mix between Undertale and The Last Of Us - seriously!

Enjoy - Brian

Ps New music and a early video demo coming soon!

notes.title: A small update
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.7
Fixed an audio glitch where the player could sometimes be heard walking after being teleported.
Fixed an intermittent glitch where the secret door remained invisible after opening.
Cleaned up some random pixel issues in the infinite graveyard (virtual groundskeeping).

: )
